news.title: Iowa grad Tony Tulathimutte receives inaugural Jack Galef Literary Arts Award
news.summary_en: Award-winning author and Iowa Writers’ Workshop graduate Tony Tulathimutte is the inaugural recipient of the Jack Galef Literary Arts Award. The new literary prize administered by the University of Iowa Writers’ Workshop is one of the largest literary prizes awarded in the United States.

news.title: UI extends contract of Athletics Director Beth Goetz
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa has extended the contract of Athletics Director Beth Goetz through Jan. 31, 2032, providing continuity in the leadership of Hawkeye athletics as the college sports landscape continues to shift.

news.title: UI launches search, names committee for next College of Law dean
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa has launched a national search for the next dean of the College of Law. The search comes as Dean Todd Pettys approaches the end of his term leading the college on June 30, 2027.
